plan.title: An exciting opportunity
plan.body: Following the success of the Grand Plan, {holder} is moving up to lead Special Projects, which has been created for the purpose. {holder} will be greatly missed from the end of month {month}. The seat is open until then, and will be filled through a fair and transparent process. Expressions of interest are welcome, and will be filed.

movedUp.title: An exciting opportunity
movedUp.body: {holder} has been seconded upstairs to Special Projects, which needed someone at short notice and has found them. {holder} will be greatly missed from the end of month {month}. The seat is open until then, and will be filled through a fair and transparent process. Expressions of interest are welcome, and will be filed.

left.title: An exciting opportunity
left.body: Following the departure of {holder}, the seat is open until the end of month {month}, and will be filled through a fair and transparent process. Until then, the team reports to whoever {holder} reported to, who has been asked to be available. Expressions of interest are welcome, and will be filed.

fired.title: An exciting opportunity
fired.body: Following a review of conduct, {holder} is no longer with the company, effective immediately, and the badge has been collected. The seat is open until the end of month {month}, and will be filled through a fair and transparent process. People and Culture would like to thank everyone who raised concerns, in confidence. Expressions of interest are welcome, and will be filed.

created.title: An exciting opportunity
created.body: A new post of Team Leader (Delivery) has been created, to lead the team that {holder} leads, so that {holder} can focus on leading it. It will be filled at the end of month {month}, through a fair and transparent process. {holder} remains in post, with the same title and a new chart. Expressions of interest are welcome, and will be filed.

won.title: Congratulations: Team lead
won.body: You have the seat. The decision was unanimous, in that one person made it. Your old colleagues now report to you, and have been asked to be pleased. Your new desk is on Floor 2, and the lift will take you there.

lost.title: Congratulations to {winner}
lost.body: After a fair and transparent process, the seat goes to {winner}, who is now your boss. Your application was strong, and has been kept on file, which is where strong applications go. You stay where you are, at the same desk, facing the other way.

blocked.title: Congratulations to {winner}
blocked.body: After a fair and transparent process, the seat goes to {winner}, who is now your boss. The incident during the process was taken into account, as the process requires. Your application has been kept on file, with the incident report stapled to the front. You stay where you are, at the same desk, facing the other way.

forYou.text: Was passed over for the seat, which went to you.

forSomeoneElse.text: Was passed over for the seat, which went to {winner}.

self.why: {decider} considered every candidate carefully, and then {decider}, and was persuaded.
self.told: {decider} considered every candidate carefully, and then {decider}, and was persuaded.

owed.why: {decider} owed {who} a favour, and this was the favour.
owed.told: {decider} and {who} go back a long way.

protege.why: {decider} has looked after {who} for years, mostly from a distance.
protege.told: {who} has worked under {decider} for some time, in one sense or another.

circle.why: {who} is in {decider}'s circle, if not at its centre.
circle.told: {who} and {decider} are often at the same lunches.

credited.why: {who} had the credit for the Grand Plan, as far as {decider} could see.
credited.told: {decider} had read the launch e-mail, and remembered whose name was on it.

calledIn.why: You called in the favour {decider} owed you.
calledIn.told: {decider} had a debt to settle, and settled it.

delivered.why: You had really done the Grand Plan, and {decider} knew it.
delivered.told: {decider} had noticed who really did the work.

results.why: You did the actual work, month after month, and {decider} had seen it.
results.told: {decider} had noticed who did the actual work.

looks.why: You looked the part: decks, confidence and the right phrases.

warm.why: What had reached {decider} of you was good.

neutral.why: {decider} had heard of you, and nothing in particular.

cold.why: What had reached {decider} of you was not good.

mistake.why: There was an incident while the seat was open, and {decider} could not be seen to reward it.
mistake.told: The incident report was taken into account by {decider}, and so was its timing.

decider.text: You came to see them about the seat, before it was filled.

sway.text: Someone they listen to put in a word for you about the seat.
Someone who owed you a favour put in a word for you about the seat.

story.text: A story that you had had very little to do with the Grand Plan.

acts.diary: A long lunch about the seat, which somebody paid for.

close: It was close, and it went to {who} on grounds that were not minuted.
untold: It was {decider}'s decision, and {decider} made it.
inFact: The seat was in the gift of {decider}. {why}

results.plan: In month {month}, {holder} moved up, and the seat went to {winner}.
results.movedUp: In month {month}, {holder} was seconded upstairs, and the seat went to {winner}.
results.left: In month {month}, after {holder} had left, the seat went to {winner}.
results.fired: In month {month}, after {holder} had been fired, the seat went to {winner}.
results.created: In month {month}, a post was created out of {holder}'s team, and it went to {winner}.

route.plan: Month {month}: {job}, by the main route. {holder} completed a Grand Plan and moved up, and the seat was yours.
route.movedUp: Month {month}: {job}. {holder} was seconded upstairs, and the seat was yours.
route.left: Month {month}: {job}. {holder} left the company, and the seat was yours.
route.fired: Month {month}: {job}, by the engineered route. {holder} was got rid of, and the seat was yours.
route.created: Month {month}: {job}. A post was created out of the team {holder} led, and it was yours.
route.demoted: Month {month}: back down to {job}, after an incident.

gone.title: A change in the team
gone.body: An all-staff e-mail thanks {holder} for their contribution, and says nothing else, at length. The desk has been cleared by somebody from Security, who took the plant. Nobody has said why, and everybody on the floor is very careful not to look at you while not saying it.

survived.title: Business as usual
survived.body: The concerns raised about {holder} have been looked into, and were found to be concerns. {holder} is staying, and has been told, in confidence, where they came from. {holder} says good morning to you now, every morning, by name, and waits for you to say it back.

remembered.text: You tried to get them fired, and they know it.
